question: Does the fixed geometric-query model learn across 33 neurons and transfer to seven gradient-disjoint development neurons?

model_reference.initialization: fresh same encoder seed 0 and head seed 101; no trained weights/Adam transfer

input.grid: same disjoint clipped grid; reference independent; all image boxes cached and inferred
input.point_features: crop-local XYZ plus whole-source affine normalized intensity
input.sampling: same exponential-race PPS without replacement; no hard foreground mask; no guide feature channel
input.guide_execution: reuse only source/recipe/hash verified PN2 guide; otherwise existing disk-backed exact operator
input.reference_empty_crop: unknown; no negative loss; retained for inference and output accounting

training.order: one deterministic permutation of every supervised box per epoch; no box oversampling
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed terminal checkpoint; no best-dev selection or automatic extension

evaluation.primary: macro per-neuron pooled per-box node precision and recall at two voxels; include all accepted predictions in all image boxes
diagnostics: length-weighted curve-to-node support at two/six voxels and target-grid support baseline
duplicate/near-duplicate proposals and unmatched outputs in reference-empty unknown boxes
training-defined apparent-width/contrast strata; SWC radius not treated as verified caliber
evaluation.metric_status: reference agreement in native voxels; not biological foreground certification or independent test performance

stratification.width: resolved image-profile apparent half-height diameter; native voxels, not anatomical caliber
stratification.contrast: image-profile inner contrast divided by observed whole-source intensity range; constant/undefined stays unresolved
stratification.percentile_rule: training-only arclength-weighted empirical inverse CDF; smallest value reaching 25 percent cumulative weight
stratification.apply_to_development: same saved training cutoffs, no per-neuron tuning; unresolved retained as its own stratum

prospective_pilot_milestones_for_review.meaning: engineering screening criteria proposed before learned development results; not universal biological quality requirements
prospective_pilot_milestones_for_review.six_voxel_and_curve_results: diagnostic explanations, never a retroactive two-voxel pass

resources.budget_status: measure actual training-prefix and full development-evaluation timing before launch; adjust wall allowance explicitly if needed, keep 9200-update cap
resources.cpu_preprocessing: separate substantial task; benchmark/reuse exact guides before bulk preparation

stop_rules: no reserved-file access or development gradients
invalid data, point/target overflow, nonfinite gradients, mode mismatch or incompatible reload stop explicitly
no target truncation, GT-conditioned inference tiles or automatic alternate sampler
fixed 20-epoch terminal verdict; no automatic extension, threshold search, checkpoint selection or GAT handoff
implementation_status: cohort audit and exposure plan only; broader cache builder, loader, metrics and training runner are not yet implemented
